_source_note: Short technical tokens that the general keyword extractor would otherwise drop. The extractor requires 4+ characters for ordinary words, because 2 and 3 character English words ('the', 'and', 'you') add noise without adding signal. That floor silently deleted every technical acronym: a resume saying 'built SQL pipelines on AWS' produced no match against a JD requiring 'experience with SQL and AWS'. Rather than lowering the floor for everything, these terms bypass it. Extend this list, do not lower min_len in tool.py.
_maintenance_note: Add a term here the first time you see a requirement fail to match because of it. Entries are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, and may contain non-letter characters (c++, c#, .net, ci/cd), which the general word regex cannot represent.
